queries: CFETR heating current drive NBI ECRH LHCD commercial fusion recirculating power efficiency

candidates.title: The time-dependent simulation of CFETR baseline steady-state scenarios
candidates.notes: Liu et al., USTC/PPPL/ASIPP. Open PDF via OSTI purl (3.6MB). Contains quantitative H&CD scenario analysis: three scenarios (NB+EC, NB+LH, LH+EC), current drive efficiencies for EC and LH, NB deposition and shine-through, ramp-up H&CD requirements. CFETR Phase I at 200 MW fusion power, 10 MA, R=5.7m. Directly addresses G-11.

candidates.title: Conceptual design of the LHCD system on CFETR
candidates.notes: ScienceDirect — abstract-only. Not triaged (budget constraint). Could provide LHCD system specs for CFETR.

candidates.title: Design status of the ECRH system for CFETR
candidates.notes: ScienceDirect — abstract-only. Not triaged (budget constraint). Would provide ECRH design specs for CFETR.

gaps_attempted.notes: OSTI CFETR steady-state scenarios paper extracted successfully. Covers H&CD portfolio (NBI + EC + LH scenarios) with quantitative current drive efficiencies and power levels. Directly addresses G-11 — H&CD portfolio selection and operational scenario design for CFETR commercial mission (Phase I: 200 MW).

summary.notes: G-11 closed with CFETR H&CD scenarios paper. G-2 partially addressed with UKAEA cost extrapolation methodology (Western analogue). G-4 failed — energychina.press abstract-only, existing cfetr-power-conversion-studies.md may already cover available literature. G-14 skipped (budget exhausted). Recommend iter-3 target G-14 via ScienceDirect CFETR sCO2/LiPb blanket paper and retry G-2 via OSTI/DOE for Chen 2015 or equivalent Chinese cost study.
